title: Sentio
tagline: Versatile data API, built for developers!  Sentio covers: search a single user's nfts, get nft metadata, get nft marketplace data, get cohort data, and get custom sql data, all in one place. Moreover, it comes with full visualisation support.
description:
We built a data indexer that
1. Does not restrict to a 'pre-defined' schema or template. Users can use the data collected by Sentio processors, or create their own in a flexible way
2. Is able to access the NFT marketplace data
3. Handles complex query computation quickly, powered by Clickhouse query engine. A few times quicker when handling bulk user and transaction volume. Write SQL online, and export it as API with 1 click. 
4. Comes with built-in visualization tool for result review and dashboardings
5. Supports cohort analysis, so that you can understand the user behaviors better

- Start experience everything from here: https://app.sentio.xyz/sentio/linea-nft/dashboards/l8C2GJlN
- Pitch deck: https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1VcxwUSaL9rJM0EU5IeOopipaPwRaUXNQnUPsr1U7Aig/edit#slide=id.g1c9684a0c49_0_83
how_its_made:
Flexible scheme to index data (w/ type-safe sdk generator), supports both time-series and relational database 
-> 
Data warehousing + Query engine for complex computation (ClickHouse) 
-> 
Quick visualisation with powerful functions
